title: Quick Dense Uruguayan Rice Pilaf
description: A sweet and dense Uruguayan dish featuring jasmine rice, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is shojin-friendly and cooked in individual mini cocottes.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium high heat.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, dried oregano, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
In a large bowl, combine jasmine rice, water, and the olive oil mixture, stirring until the rice is well coated.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the rice mixture and stir until they are evenly distributed.
Add the raisins to the rice mixture and stir until they are evenly distributed.
Divide the rice mixture among 4 individual mini cocottes.
Place the mini cocottes on the preheated yakimono grill and cook for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the mini cocottes from the grill and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Quick Dense Uruguayan Rice Pilaf hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
